Title: General availability: Automatic Backup for App Service Environment and Azure Functions Dedicated Hosting

Body.Content:
Automatic Backup for web apps deployed to App Service Environment V2 & V3 and function apps deployed to Azure Functions dedicated hosting plans is now generally available.

The benefits of automatic backups inlude :

  • Automatic backups are made for your app regularly as long as it's in a supported pricing tier. No additional configuration is required.
  • Automatic backups support upto 30 GB backup size
  • Automatic backups do not require storage account configuration

Please refer to the document available here Back up an app - Azure App Service for details.
